candidate_name: CASAR-G2a — Certified Adaptive Salience & Assembly Router
purpose: Retain G1d immutable semantic epochs and sparse between-call activation, but route activation only where it adds expected cognitive value and govern utility learning against self-reinforcing salience attractors, poisoning and semantic-role/time leakage.

layers.role: immutable typed role/time/provenance graph epochs + validated delta overlays
sparse cue/event-driven salience with lazy decay, bounded propagation and inhibition
choose BYPASS, SUPPLEMENT, ESCALATE or QUARANTINE before Assembly formation
constrain learned salience using context reachability, bounded gain, inhibition, diversity/novelty reserve and poisoning/feedback monitors
freeze bounded typed candidate collections on graph+activation+basis witnesses
receipt for anchors, relation roles, time, query/activation paths, collection semantics, selection plan, utility provenance and cost

epoch_contract.publish_rule: canonical event/state commit first -> derive delta -> validate provenance/status/role/time -> immutable publish -> activation may rebase/reference published epoch
epoch_contract.reader_rule: one Assembly pins one graph epoch; mixed semantic epochs invalid
epoch_contract.failure_rule: failed or UNKNOWN derivation validation leaves prior epoch current and exact retrieval available

typed_relation_identity.rule: pairwise lexical similarity or vector proximity cannot substitute for role-aware relation identity; n-ary roles remain explicit

BYPASS.rule: use exact/FTS/direct path; background salience cannot demote a known exact route

SUPPLEMENT.rule: truthful compatible activation may rerank/seed a bounded candidate set

ESCALATE.rule: combine explicit retrieval seeds + activation + bounded graph traversal; exact-anchor validation remains required

QUARANTINE.rule: ignore or isolate learned salience; broaden/retrieve/validate explicitly

activation_utility_receipt.invariant: utility receipt may update salience/routing only; it is never a truth/status/authority transition

anti_attractor_governor.credit_rule: do not assign one downstream scalar reward indiscriminately to every surfaced memory; prefer item/path causal credit, otherwise mark UNKNOWN and use bounded conservative update
anti_attractor_governor.default_when_credit_unknown: no positive reinforcement beyond bounded exploration prior

tcqs_assembly_contract.path_or_evidence_multiplicity: MULTISET<Ref> only when multiplicity is explicitly semantic
tcqs_assembly_contract.rule: collection kind is part of candidate semantic identity; same member bytes under different collection algebra are different candidate states when order/multiplicity/weights affect downstream behavior

assembly_contract.rule: Assembly is temporary candidate state, not persistent truth; current/consequential assertions require exact-anchor validation

hard_invariants: canonical truth outranks graph and activation
exact routes may bypass learned salience
shuffled/stale/role-invalid/temporal-invalid fields cannot count as truthful continuity
same candidate bytes + changed collection semantics can mean changed candidate identity
record provenance != cognitive utility != selection-plan integrity
memory authentication does not prove memory usefulness

frank_mapping.M.CLAYGRAPH_MEMORY: semantic epochs + latent field + CASAR router/governor + Assembly compiler
frank_mapping.M.WORKSPACE_ARBITER: receives Assembly candidates after ClayGraph routing; competition/ignition remains separate
frank_mapping.M.MRSC: projects typed Assembly collections to reader rail with view receipt

evidence_boundary.external: independent support for active temporal/hybrid graph memory plus independent risks from oversmoothing/context interference/memory poisoning
